scope: Private injected native-risk protocol, NOT a public Vertex schema or a capability token

rustApi.sideEffects: None. No clock, file access, process, network, broker, runtime or default transport. No pyo3 requirement.

encoding.canonical: All request and response bytes use injected ContractAuthority.encode. Request rejects alternate whitespace and duplicate-key encodings.
encoding.decimals: Canonical base-10 strings, at most 18 fractional digits, checked i128 coefficient. Overflow or inexact arithmetic rejects. Never float.
encoding.nanoseconds: Nonnegative canonical decimal integer strings, checked i128. Used also for journal revision and owner epoch.
encoding.objects: All internal structs reject unknown fields. Every nonoptional field is required. Optional members are explicitly null when absent.

request.request_id: Identifier; reservation identity on initial admission
request.strategy_artifact_id: Exact immutable StrategySpec artifactId, not strategyId/version alias
request.strategy: Direct authoritative public StrategySpec object, native v1 validation
request.intents: Direct authoritative public TradeIntent objects, ordered one-to-one with legs; proposalOnly true, executionAuthorized false, environment paper, DAY limit only
request.journal: ObservedJournal from sole fenced local owner, never a PortfolioSnapshot conversion
request.dispatch_reservation_key: Identifier|null; exact current pending reservation to replace rather than add twice

response.reasons: stable reason code strings; admitted means paper-reservation-plan-only

types.authoritativeDefinitions: services/execution-kernel/src/model.rs; calendar types in src/calendar.rs; checked Decimal in src/decimal.rs

ObservedJournal.reconciled_at_ns: Ns local reconciliation/ingestion timestamp, observed_at_ns <= reconciled_at_ns <= now_ns

ObservedPosition.unit_notional: positive Decimal, already includes contract multiplier
ObservedPosition.unit_greeks: Greeks already per position unit, including multiplier
ObservedPosition.settled_quantity: signed Decimal bounded by quantity, ONLY settled equity quantity supplies cover
ObservedPosition.covered_shares_encumbered: map underlying ID to nonnegative Decimal

Reservation.expiry_notionals: map local expiry date to Decimal

Leg.intent_hash: native digest of corresponding direct TradeIntent

MarketQuote.currency: ISO currency, exact policy currency for both option and underlying; no FX fallback

OptionTerms.expiry_ns: Ns proven unique using pinned calendar intervals

CostPolicy.slippage_bps: Decimal includes at least StrategySpec spreadBps + slippageBps

ZeroDteGate.owner_review_verified: boolean from trusted owner resolver, not an agent assertion

LegPlan.maximum_loss: Decimal including cash_reservation and pessimistic share-settlement risk
LegPlan.gross_notional: Decimal underlying/strike worst exposure including multiplier

trustedConverterRequirements: Only the authenticated local owner resolves approved immutable policy, calendar transition tables, qualification, entitlement, prices/Greeks, exact reviewed strategy and 0DTE evidence. Caller-authored IDs do not prove approval.
No fabricated defaults for exchange, calendar, cutoff, exercise, settlement, currency, multiplier, quote ages, fees, slippage, latency or limits. Missing required evidence fails closed.

Policy pins complete instrument and calendar digests, exact immutable StrategySpec artifact ID and digest. Calendar supplies contiguous explicit UTC-offset intervals with timezone/tzdb/version and exchange-local sessions, holidays and early closes.

Journal source must include ALL sleeves, positions, pending reservations, settlement obligations, durable kill status, continuity and unresolved acceptance. SQL/public PortfolioSnapshot is never spendable.

For dispatch replacement, key must refer to exactly one existing pending Reservation with identical strategy_artifact_id, sleeve and proposal_hashes. Positions representing existing fills are retained. Unknown acceptance remains globally blocked. No release implied.
Owner must CAS journal_id/revision/head_hash/owner_epoch and persist entire Reservation including Greek/exposure intervals per sleeve before simulator dispatch; plan alone never reserves anything.
Owner must retain or replace reservations atomically; keep unresolved fills/assignment/cancel exposure until reconciliation. Do not spend unsettled proceeds.

Every leg reserves independent adverse partial-fill exposure. No assumed package atomicity or offsetting future leg fills. Physical long-call exercise reserves strike cash beyond premium; physical long put and short call require existing settled shares; short put reserves strike cash; naked cash-settled short calls reject. No margin/borrow/FX assumption.

0DTE requires explicit owner-resolved review, intraday dataset/replay, expiry scenarios, rapid exits and partial-leg evidence. IDs are provenance inputs, not a kernel claim that external gates passed. No live permission exists.
